categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: Baboomtown Square

locations.title: Banana Mine Scaffold

locations.title: Checkpoint - SL1
locations.description: After collecting [Banandium Gem 02 - Through the Banana-Mining Belt](#loc=466314), dig straight down and  use the explosives to find the checkpoint on top of a platform in the room you reveal.

locations.title: Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Associated Banandium Gem:** [36 - Ingot Isle Chip Exchange](#loc=494550)

locations.title: 01 - The First Banandium Gem
locations.description: In the tutorial area - after the very first cutscene, head to the end of the tunnel right in front of you.

locations.title: 02 - Through the Banana-Mining Belt
locations.description: After collecting [Banandium Gem 01](#loc=466313), you'll find this banana at the end of a tunnel with a red girder archway that has a conveyor belt of dirt moving through it.

locations.title: 03 - Digging Up a Snack
locations.description: **Location:** In a pile of dirt right next to the [Checkpoint - SL1](#loc=466315)

locations.title: 05 - Gold Rush!
locations.description: In the middle of a golden path.

locations.title: 06 - Shifty Smash: Rising Tower
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=494527)

locations.title: 07 - Shifty Smash: Break Up the Ring
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=494529)

locations.title: 04 - Secret by the Start
locations.description: **Location:** In an underground area, reached by using Snake Bananza to bounce up a seemingly dead-end room at the start of the path where you find [05 - Gold Rush!](#loc=494526)

locations.title: 08 - Thwarting the Thorns
locations.description: **Location:** Inside a cluster of thorns on a floating platform. Throw a chunk of terrain or suck them up with Elephant Bananza, then fly onto the platform with Ostrich Bananza to collect it.

locations.title: 09 - Ingot Isle Fragmentone Recovery
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for bringing one Fragmentone back to its body. Use Kong Bananza to smash through the concrete blocking the path.

locations.title: 10 - Ingot Isle Fragmentone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for bringing all three Fragmentones back to their body. Use Kong Bananza to smash through the concrete blocking the path.

locations.title: 16 - Snack in a Sunken Slab
locations.description: **Location:** Underwater, in a slab of concrete. Jump and down-attack while in Kong Bananza form to collect it.

locations.title: 15 - Post-Sprint Treat
locations.description: **Location:** In a high-up box reached by running across the crumbly dirt in Zebra Bananza form.

locations.title: 12 - The Ingot Isle Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for giving the Growtone 1000 gold.

locations.title: 13 - The Hungry Ingot Isle Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for giving the Growtone 5000 gold.

locations.title: 14 - The Sated Ingot Isle Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for giving the Growtone 10,000 gold.

locations.title: 11 - Shifty Smash: Checkerboard Crush
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=494542)

locations.title: 33 - Shifty Smash: Quick & Nimble
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=494545).

locations.title: 36 - Ingot Isle Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Exchanged for Banandium Chips at the [Chip Exchange](#loc=494549)

locations.title: 19 - Ingot Isle Quiz Master
locations.description:
**Location:** Reward for correctly answering the Quiztone's questions, listed below.

- What sort of tool does Grumpy Kong always keep handy?
  - A pickax
- What are Poppy Kong's earrings shaped like?
  - Banandium Chips
- Which of these accessories does Void Kong wear?
  - A bow tie

locations.title: 18 - Ingot Isle Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by Smashintone after smashing through 99,999 cubic metres of gold in this layer.

locations.title: 21 - Cranky's Ingot Isle Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by [Cranky Kong](#loc=494556)

locations.title: 20 - Decked Out in Gold
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by Glamtone if you speak to them while wearing the Bananergy Tie, Banandium-Gold Fur and Gold Britches.

locations.title: 17 - Ingot Isle Hide-and-Seek
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for finding [Hiddentone 1](#loc=494554), [Hiddentone 2](#loc=494558), [Hiddentone 3](#loc=494555) and [Hiddentone 4](#loc=494559).

locations.title: 22 - Finished Four Fights!
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing 4 waves of the [Battle Rush](#loc=494562).

locations.title: 23 - Beat Eight Bouts!

locations.title: 24 - Won Thirteen Throwdowns!

locations.title: 25 - Battle Rush Cleared!
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing every wave of the [Battle Rush](#loc=494562).

locations.title: 26 - Kong-quered Inflammonite!
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing this boss's wave of the [Boss Rush](#loc=494567).

locations.description: **Location:** On top of the crane that only appears after paying Grumpy Kong 120,000 gold.

locations.title: 35 - The Best of the Bunch

locations.title: Cranky Kong
locations.description: On top of the metal overhang.

locations.title: Treasure Chest

locations.title: Battle Rush
locations.description:
**Location:** Created by Grumpy Kong after you hand over 5,000 Gold.

**Opponents:**
- Battle 1: 7 Crockoids
- Battle 2: 7 Crockoids
- Battle 3: 5 Antickoids
- Battle 4: 10 Munchoids
- Battle 5: 30 Squeeloids
- Battle 6: 2 Muckoids
- Battle 7: 5 Stompoids
- Battle 8: 11 Antickoids
- Battle 9: 7 Rolluskoids
- Battle 10: 5 Buzzoids
- Battle 11: 4 Batteroid
- Battle 12: 14 Wallopoids
- Battle 13: 1 Grumpy Kong

**Rewards:**
- [22 - Finished Four Fights!](#loc=494563)
- [23 - Beat Eight Bouts!](#loc=494564)
- [24 - Won Thirteen Throwdowns!](#loc=494565)
- [25 - Battle Rush Cleared!](#loc=494566)

locations.title: Shifty Smash Challenge
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of a pink metal arch.

**Strategy:** Use Snake Bananza to jump on top of the pillar, then Kong Bananza to tear out chunks and swing them.

**Reward:** [06 - Shifty Smash: Rising Tower](#loc=494528)

locations.title: Shifty Smash Challenge
locations.description:
**Location:** On the island.

**Strategy:** Climb on the dirt pillar and use Elephant Bananza to suck up the ring as it flies by!

**Reward:** [07 - Shifty Smash: Break Up the Ring](#loc=494530)

locations.title: Shifty Smash Challenge
locations.description:
**Location:** In a room at the end of the tunnel behind the warp gong

**Strategy:** Use Elephant Bananza and inhale while running around the checkerboard.

**Reward:** [11 - Shifty Smash: Checkerboard Crush](#loc=494543)

locations.title: Shifty Smash Challenge
locations.description:
**Location:** On a high-up dirt mound.

**Strategy:** Use Elephant Bananza and aim up while sucking in the rapidly spinning cubes.

**Reward:** [33 - Shifty Smash: Quick & Nimble](#loc=494546)
